title: Potion Split Showdown
audienceRationale: Reina's history shows huge engagement with rapid, high-repetition mastery loops (167 completions at perfect accuracy in a checking-style activity) plus enjoyment of chance-reveal spinners. Potion Split Showdown pairs a fast compare-and-verify loop with a spin-to-reveal challenge generator, feeding her love of precision streaks without copying any prior activity.
openingPromise: Two rival potion bottles, one gulp each — pick the bigger sip and out-brew the Shadow Alchemist.
firstThreeSeconds: A glowing cauldron room fades in. A brass reveal-wheel spins on its own and clunks to a stop, stamping two fraction cards onto the table: 1/3 and 1/6. A voice whispers: 'Bigger sip wins. Tap it.'
firstAction: Tap one of two identical-size potion bottles, each divided into a different number of equal doses (e.g., 3 doses vs. 6 doses) with exactly one dose glowing. The child taps the bottle whose single glowing dose looks bigger.
interactionDemonstration: A ghostly hand demos round zero: it taps 1/2 vs 1/8, the two bottles slide together and overlap transparently so the halves and eighths line up, showing the half-dose towering over the eighth-dose. A caption reads: 'Fewer parts → bigger parts.' No penalty on the demo.
coreInteraction: Each round: the reveal-wheel spins and lands on a fraction pair (denominators 2–8, same-size bottles). The child (1) taps the bigger sip or a 'same size' scale icon, (2) drags the correct symbol >, <, or = into the comparison slot between the fraction cards, and (3) picks or speaks a reasoning tile such as 'The whole is cut into fewer parts, so each part is bigger.' Bottles then overlay to visually verify the answer.
mathAsPower: Correct comparisons pour the bigger sip into Reina's cauldron, charging a Brew Meter. Correct reasoning statements add a 'Certainty Seal' that doubles the pour. The mathematics — knowing more parts means smaller parts — is literally the fuel that out-brews the rival.
stakes: The Shadow Alchemist's cauldron auto-fills slowly each round. If Reina's Brew Meter falls behind for three straight rounds, the Alchemist steals a Certainty Seal.
consequences: A wrong tap or wrong symbol triggers the overlay: bottles fuse and the parts align so the size difference is undeniable; the round scores no pour, but nothing is lost except tempo. Wrong reasoning tiles gray out with a one-line hint ('Count the parts — which bottle has fewer cuts?').
recovery: After any miss, a 'Re-Brew' round appears with the same denominators but the bottles pre-overlaid, letting Reina answer with visual support and reclaim half the pour. Stolen Seals are recoverable by winning two consecutive full rounds.
progression: Round set 1: far-apart denominators (1/2 vs 1/8, 1/3 vs 1/7) with bottles always visible and partitioned.
Round set 2: closer denominators (1/5 vs 1/6, 1/6 vs 1/8) plus occasional equal pairs (1/4 vs 1/4) to earn the '=' scale.
Round set 3: fraction cards shown first, bottles hidden until after the symbol is placed — compare from the numbers alone, then verify visually.
Boss Brew: five rapid comparisons with reasoning required on at least three to seal the Alchemist's cauldron shut.
worldReaction: The cauldron bubbles higher and changes color with each correct pour; potion imps cheer and chant the reasoning back ('Fewer cuts, bigger sip!'); the Shadow Alchemist visibly sweats as the meter gap grows.
payoff: Winning the Boss Brew crowns Reina 'Master of the Bigger Sip' and unlocks a trophy shelf showing her fastest correct streak and best reasoning statements — evidence of at least 4 correct comparisons and 3 justifications, satisfying the node goal.
replayVariation: The reveal-wheel reshuffles pairs each run; new potion themes (fire brew, moon brew) reskin bottles as bars or circles; a Speed Brew mode leans into streak-chasing; a Judge mode flips roles so Reina grades the imps' comparisons and fixes wrong symbols.
visualDirection: Cozy alchemist workshop: deep purples and teals, warm candlelight, glass bottles with luminous liquid doses, chunky rounded UI cards. Equal-size bottles are visually emphasized with matching gold rims.
motionDirection: Wheel spins with satisfying deceleration and clunk; bottle overlay is a smooth slide-and-fade alignment; correct pours arc liquid into the cauldron with a splash; Brew Meter rises with elastic easing.
soundDirection: Bubbling ambience, ratchet ticks on the wheel, a rich glug on correct pours, a soft glass 'tink' plus whispered hint on misses, rising choral shimmer as the Brew Meter nears full.
engagementPrediction: High: the loop mirrors her demonstrated appetite for fast, repeatable verification tasks with visible streaks, and the spinner reveal taps her wheel-of-fortune enjoyment. Expect long sessions chasing perfect Boss Brews.
falsifyingEvidence: If Reina answers by tapping visuals but repeatedly fails hidden-bottle rounds or skips/randomizes reasoning tiles (reasoning accuracy under ~60% across 10+ rounds), the design is masking guessing with visuals; if frustration events (rapid re-taps, quits after Seal theft) exceed her historical ~0.27 baseline, the stakes system is misfiring.
